Under what conditions could empathy increase political polarization?

Empathy can increase political polarization under certain conditions. When individuals are exposed to extreme or polarizing viewpoints through media, it can limit their exposure to diverse perspectives. This echo-chamber effect can intensify emotional responses and reduce the ability to empathize with those who hold opposing views. Additionally, when people experience a sense of threat or competition over resources, it can heighten emotional responses and make it harder to empathize with others. Effective communication strategies that encourage perspective-taking and shared experiences might help mitigate these effects.
